apps.subtitle: Variant: no plugins
apps.localizedDescription:
## What's New

**Wide emotes at full size.** With Keep Wide Emote Shape on (Settings → Emotes, on by default), wide 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes now show at the same height as normal emotes, and the chat line makes room for them so nothing overlaps.

**Much faster emotes.** Third-party emotes now show up almost instantly, even in busy chats. Each channel's emote list is remembered between launches, emote images load from a smaller format, and each image is only prepared once.

**Fixed emotes showing as plain text.** If two channels used the same name for different emotes, the second channel's emote could show as text. Each channel now gets its own emotes, and a channel's emote wins over a global one with the same name, like the 7TV extension.

**Your own emotes show up.** When you send a message with a 7TV, BTTV or FFZ emote, it now shows as the emote in your own chat right away instead of as text (wide ones at full size too), and the chat box previews it while you type.

**7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes in Twitch's emote picker.** Twitch's own emote picker now lists the channel's and global 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes in two extra sections, below your Twitch emotes.

**Chat Text Size.** New option in Settings → Chat to make chat messages bigger: Default, Large, or Extra Large. Only chat messages change size; the rest of the app stays the same.

**Bigger Emote Size steps.** Large and Extra Large are now noticeably bigger than Default.

|------|-------------|

| `tv.twitch-32.1-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.24-no-plugins.ipa` | Sideload IPA without app extensions (TrollStore) |

| `com.level3tjg.twitchadblock_0.1.24_iphoneos-arm64.deb` | Rootless deb (Dopamine / palera1n) |
